verdicts.reason: A is basically the original shrunk to fit, with no rearranging. Still, it keeps the dot patterns, the blue image band and the ampersand/BEDDING lockup with clear gaps between them. Its flaws: 'Baby Toddler' is tiny and hard to read at 50px tall, and BEDDING sits close to the right edge. B has more problems: it squashes the blue image into a thin sliver on the left, which leaves a large, dead dark area. It drops the dot texture, and it jams BEDDING right up against 'Toddler', so the lockup reads as one cramped, colliding string, again with 'Baby Toddler' too small to read.
